modules.name: Mobile App – Watchman
modules.description: The watchman's mobile app for handling visitor entry and exit at the society gate.

requirements.title: Show today's expected visitors
requirements.description: The watchman app must show the list of visitors expected today.

requirements.title: Search visitors by name, mobile or pass code
requirements.description: The watchman must be able to search for a visitor by name, mobile number or pass code.

requirements.title: Add walk-in visitor with automatic resident notification
requirements.description: The watchman must be able to add a walk-in visitor, and the resident is informed automatically.

requirements.title: Tap to call flat's resident
requirements.description: The watchman must be able to tap to call the resident of a flat when needed.

requirements.title: Record visitor entry and exit time
requirements.description: The app must record the entry time and exit time of visitors.

requirements.title: Offline entry saving with later sync
requirements.description: The app must save entries when there is no network and send them later.
